CALENDAR_ACCOUNT_NOT_SIGNED_IN: A calendar account is not signed in.
CALENDAR_CONFIG_MISSING: The calendar bridge configuration is missing.
CALENDAR_MASS_DELETE_GUARD: The sync would delete too many events at once, so it stops (a half-empty source looks like this).
Check the source; allow the delete on purpose if right.
GCAL_HTTP_409: The calendar event already exists (a retried insert).
